PC Errata 2013 slip of [[For Luck]]: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card, titled “•For Luck”. Cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 23 of the sheet. Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of January 1, 2013”), [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf], PDF page 23; the PDF was made on 16 April 2013 (file metadata). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive] (9 August 2016; SHA-1 of the archived file 3453cd4bee7d22faa58e3cfa492bea8021b2578c). Shown on [[For Luck (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].
